name: setup
js: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const M = () => GMMC.getMap(); const L = () => M().lines.find(l => l.id === 'l1'); const d = document.getElementById('setupDialog'); if (d && d.open) d.close(); localStorage.clear(); await sleep(200); document.querySelector('[data-pickline=l1]').click(); await sleep(300); return { line: L().name, path: L().path.length, rows: document.querySelectorAll('#patStopList .pat-row').length, freqFields: document.querySelectorAll('#inspector [data-f^="ln.freq"]').length }; })()

name: markers-before
js: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const M = () => GMMC.getMap(); const L = () => M().lines.find(l => l.id === 'l1'); window.__m0 = document.querySelectorAll('#viewport g[data-st] circle[stroke-width]').length; return window.__m0; })()

name: toggle-passes
js: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const M = () => GMMC.getMap(); const L = () => M().lines.find(l => l.id === 'l1'); const chips = [...document.querySelectorAll('#patStopList .pat-chip[data-pat=toggle]:not(:disabled)')]; const c = chips[2]; window.__skipId = c.dataset.st; c.click(); await sleep(300); const m1 = document.querySelectorAll('#viewport g[data-st] circle[stroke-width]').length; const label = [...document.querySelectorAll('#patStopList .pat-chip')].find(x => x.dataset.st === window.__skipId).textContent; return { before: window.__m0, after: m1, skip: L().skip, chip: label, hasMarker: !!document.querySelector('#viewport g[data-st="' + window.__skipId + '"] circle[stroke-width]') }; })()

name: toggle-back
js: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const M = () => GMMC.getMap(); const L = () => M().lines.find(l => l.id === 'l1'); [...document.querySelectorAll('#patStopList .pat-chip')].find(x => x.dataset.st === window.__skipId).click(); await sleep(300); return { skip: L().skip, markers: document.querySelectorAll('#viewport g[data-st] circle[stroke-width]').length }; })()

name: set-freq
js: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const M = () => GMMC.getMap(); const L = () => M().lines.find(l => l.id === 'l1'); const set = (k, v) => { const i = document.querySelector('[data-f="ln.' + k + '"]'); i.value = v; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }; set('freqPeak', 4); set('freqMidday', 6); set('freqEvening', 8); set('freqWeekend', 12); await sleep(300); const badge = document.querySelector('#viewport .freq[data-line="l1"] text'); return { freq: L().freq, badge: badge && badge.textContent }; })()

name: branch
js: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const M = () => GMMC.getMap(); const L = () => M().lines.find(l => l.id === 'l1'); const paths0 = document.querySelectorAll('#viewport path[stroke]').length; const pl = L().path.filter(r => r[0] !== '@'); const from = pl[3]; const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('#patStopList .pat-mini')].find(b => b.dataset.st === from); btn.click(); await sleep(300); const armed = L().branches; const other = Object.keys(M().stations).find(id => !pl.includes(id)); const target = document.querySelector('#viewport g[data-st="' + other + '"]') ; let appended = null; if (target) { const r = target.getBoundingClientRect(); target.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, button: 0, clientX: r.x + r.width/2, clientY: r.y + r.height/2 })); await sleep(300); appended = L().branches[0].length; } if (!appended || appended < 2) { GMMC.checkpoint(); L().branches[0] = [from, other]; GMMC.changed(); await sleep(300); appended = 'programmatic'; } const paths1 = document.querySelectorAll('#viewport path[stroke]').length; return { armed, appended, branches: L().branches, pathsBefore: paths0, pathsAfter: paths1, branchRows: document.querySelectorAll('.pat-branches .pat-row').length }; })()

name: frequent-style
js: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const M = () => GMMC.getMap(); const L = () => M().lines.find(l => l.id === 'l1'); const widths = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('#viewport path[stroke="' + L().color + '"]')].map(p => p.getAttribute('stroke-width')).filter(Boolean); const w0 = widths(); document.getElementById('settingsBtn').click(); await sleep(300); const sw = document.getElementById('setFreqWeight'); sw.checked = true; sw.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(200); document.getElementById('settingsDialog').close(); await sleep(200); const w1 = widths(); const i = document.querySelector('[data-f="ln.freqPeak"]'); i.value = 20; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(300); const w2 = widths(); return { off: [...new Set(w0)], on4: [...new Set(w1)], on20: [...new Set(w2)], setting: GMMC.getSettings().freqWeight }; })()

name: save-reload
js: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const M = () => GMMC.getMap(); const L = () => M().lines.find(l => l.id === 'l1'); const json = GMMC.projectJson(); const obj = JSON.parse(json); const l = obj.map.lines.find(x => x.id === 'l1'); const ok = GMMC.loadJson(json); await sleep(400); return { saved: { freq: l.freq, skip: l.skip, branches: l.branches, fw: obj.settings.freqWeight }, loaded: ok, after: { freq: L().freq, branches: L().branches, fw: GMMC.getSettings().freqWeight } }; })()

name: skip-persist
js: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const M = () => GMMC.getMap(); const L = () => M().lines.find(l => l.id === 'l1'); document.querySelector('[data-pickline=l1]').click(); await sleep(200); if (GMMC.getSelection() === null) document.querySelector('[data-pickline=l1]').click(); await sleep(200); const chips = [...document.querySelectorAll('#patStopList .pat-chip[data-pat=toggle]:not(:disabled)')]; chips[5].click(); await sleep(300); const id = chips[5].dataset.st; const json = GMMC.projectJson(); GMMC.loadJson(json); await sleep(300); return { skipAfterLoad: L().skip, id }; })()

name: old-format
js: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const M = () => GMMC.getMap(); const L = () => M().lines.find(l => l.id === 'l1'); const old = { version: 1, title: 'Old', stations: { a: { name: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 }, b: { name: 'B', x: 3, y: 0 }, c: { name: 'C', x: 6, y: 0 } }, lines: [{ id: 'x', name: 'X', color: '#112233', path: ['a', 'b', 'c'], freq: { peak: 5, offpeak: 9 }, skip: ['b', 'zz'] }] }; GMMC.loadJson(JSON.stringify(old)); await sleep(300); const l = GMMC.getMap().lines[0]; const badge = document.querySelector('#viewport .freq text'); return { freq: l.freq, skip: l.skip, badge: badge && badge.textContent, markers: document.querySelectorAll('#viewport g[data-st] circle[stroke-width]').length }; })()

name: gtha-data
js: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const M = () => GMMC.getMap(); const L = () => M().lines.find(l => l.id === 'l1'); GMMC.newMap('gtha'); await sleep(500); const l = GMMC.getMap().lines.find(x => x.freq && (x.freq.peak || x.freq.offpeak)); return { name: l && l.name, freq: l && l.freq, text: l && GMMC.freqText(l) }; })()
